name: Stage 23:1: Flen (Hammarvallen) to Harpsundsvägen
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 23:1, Flen (Hammarvallen) to Harpsundsvägen.
utilities: Flen is the practical service base, with rail/bus access at Flen station, station toilet/service context, grocery/food options in town, and Hammarvallen parking/start facilities nearby. Local Flen transit changed in December 2025 to app-booked 'När du vill' traffic on weekdays, so plan the station-to-start leg with live Sörmlandstrafiken or walk it.

Hammarvallen has sports/swimming-hall facilities with opening-hour or paid-entry-dependent toilets/changing; Flens Bowlingcafé at Hammarvallen is a separate opening-hour-dependent food/fika option, not an all-hours trail service.
Lida Gård is an official alternate start/parking option with opening-hour-dependent restaurant/cafe/shop service; starting there adds distance compared with Hammarvallen.

No on-stage shelter, toilet, shop, or all-hours tap was verified after leaving Flen/Hammarvallen. Harpsundsvägen is a roadside stage-change point with no confirmed parking or services, so plan pickup, continue to 23:2, or arrange transport carefully.

Orrhammaren has route-adjacent swim/rest opportunities, but the formal serviced public beach is Orrestaöbadet across the lake/off the core trail. Do not treat private Orrhammaren bathing areas as guaranteed public facilities.
waterSources: Carry water from Flen, Hammarvallen, or Lida. The only verified on-stage water point is Vikmanstorp spring after about 7 km, and Sörmlandsleden explicitly warns that it is unreliable in summer and may dry out.
Orrhammaren and nearby lakes are natural/untested water only. Treat/filter any natural water and do not count beach or private-facility services as a trail refill.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 10 km from Flen/Hammarvallen to Harpsundsvägen. OSM relation 9637570 is the correct Stage 23:1 relation, but it includes a disconnected Lida Gård alternate-start branch; the main component is about 10.2 km, while all relation members total about 13 km.
Treat 23:1 and 23:2 as the two halves of the Flen-Hälleforsnäs connection, handing off at the same Harpsundsvägen trailhead. Do not stitch 23:1 into the main Stage 23 Hälleforsnäs-Svalboviken route.
Third-party maps and station-access variants range roughly from 9.4-11.6 km, and the Lida Gård-Harpsundsvägen variant is about 13.5 km. Keep official 10 km for the Hammarvallen start.

Official Sörmlandsleden and current local listings show the stage active with no public fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Recent 2025 AllTrails reports were positive, but still treat wet boardwalks, roots and steep Orrhammaren footing as weather-dependent hazards.

Åtorpskogen nature reserve is crossed/edged by the route. Do not damage living or dead trees/shrubs, do not collect/damage invertebrate habitats, and avoid organized camps/competitions without permission. Dead bark-beetle-damaged spruce can fall, especially after wind or heavy rain.

A roughly 100 m boardwalk over stream/wet ground near Åtorpskogen/Orrhammaren can be slippery or springy when wet; older reports describe it as passable rather than closed. Flens local rules also restrict cycling/riding on municipal exercise tracks, and Sörmlandsleden is a hiking route.

Older hiker reports mention clear-cut or young-forest roughness between Orrhammarens fritidsområde and Vikmanstorp, but the trail was still preserved and later reports describe easy-to-follow orange marking. Keep the GPX/current markings visible.

Harpsundsvägen has no confirmed parking, toilet, water, shelter, or reliable transit right at the endpoint. Complementary rural traffic may require advance booking and should not be treated as casual trail-exit transit. Do not imply open public access to Harpsund residence, protected shoreline, boat facilities or restricted roads from this trail junction.

facilities.name: Flen station access
facilities.description: Rail/bus hub for the stage start, with station service/toilet context. Official and hiker reports describe the walk to Hammarvallen as straightforward; verify 'När du vill' local transport or plan to walk.

facilities.name: ICA Kvantum Flen
facilities.description: Practical grocery/resupply in central Flen before the stage. Check current opening hours.

facilities.name: Hammarvallen official start and parking
facilities.description: Official stage start with nearby parking/access. Follow local signs for allowed parking and overnight rules.

facilities.name: Hammarvallen bus/local access context
facilities.description: Nearby stop/local-access context only. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken and the app-booked 'När du vill' service rather than relying on old fixed-line assumptions.

facilities.name: Hammarvallen sports facilities
facilities.description: Sports/swimming-hall facility context with opening-hour or paid-entry-dependent toilets/changing; not an all-hours trail toilet/tap.

facilities.name: Flens Bowlingcafé
facilities.description: Opening-hour-dependent food/fika option at Hammarvallen; verify current opening hours before depending on it.

facilities.name: Lida alternate start/parking
facilities.description: Official alternate start and parking at Lida Gård. Lida to Hammarvallen is about 3.5 km; Lida to Harpsundsvägen is about 13.5 km.

facilities.name: Lida Gård cafe/restaurant/shop
facilities.description: Opening-hour-dependent restaurant, cafe and shop service at the alternate start; verify current hours before relying on food.

facilities.name: Orrhammaren route-adjacent swim/rest
facilities.description: Approximate route-adjacent swimming/rest context near Orrhammaren from official text and hiker reports. A 2022 report used a scout-cabin/grill/bathing-jetty area for a break, but public-use rights and facilities are not fully verified.

facilities.name: Orrestaöbadet formal public beach
facilities.description: Formal serviced public beach across the lake/off the core route, with seasonal toilets/changing/grill/camping context. Smoking and dogs are prohibited on the bathing place; 2026 bathing-water class was excellent, but check current samples seasonally.

facilities.name: Åtorpskogen reserve and falling-tree warning
facilities.description: Reserve rules apply and bark-beetle-damaged dead spruce can fall suddenly, especially in wind or after heavy rain.

facilities.name: Åtorpskogen/Orrhammaren boardwalk caution
facilities.description: Approximate 100 m boardwalk/wet-ground section. Hiker reports describe slippery or springy boards when wet/cold and rooty or steep footing near Orrhammaren, but not a closure.

facilities.name: Orrhammaren-Vikmanstorp clear-cut roughness
facilities.description: Older reports mention clear-cut/young-forest roughness in this corridor; the route remained passable but markings/GPX are useful.

facilities.name: Vikmanstorp spring
facilities.description: Only official stage water point, after about 7 km. It can dry out in summer and has no potable-water guarantee; carry enough from Flen/Lida and treat/filter if used.

facilities.name: Harpsundsvägen endpoint no-services warning
facilities.description: Roadside stage-change point shared with stage 23:2. Sörmlandsleden 23:2 says no parking here; no toilet, tap, shelter, table, or reliable transit was verified.

facilities.name: Harpsundsvägen weak-transit caveat
facilities.description: Do not count on spontaneous endpoint transit. Plan pickup, continue on 23:2 to Hälleforsnäs, arrange taxi, or verify any complementary rural traffic well in advance.

facilities.name: Harpsund side-trip access caveat
facilities.description: Harpsund is a protected-object area. Follow all signs, barriers and photography/depiction restrictions; do not imply open public access to residence, shoreline, boat facilities, restricted roads or gates from this junction.
